section: Largest rank movements in the 2025 cycle
subtitle: Year-on-year rank changes (2024 → 2025) reveal where voting behavior converged with, or moved sharply away from, the global UNGA majority.
metric: Pillar 3 — Global Alignment (alignment with the prevailing UNGA majority position).

source.rank_convention: 1 = highest global alignment; positive rank_delta = improved (rose); negative = fell.
source.universe: 191 countries with both 2024 and 2025 Pillar 3 records (AFG and VEN excluded — no recorded 2025 votes).

headline_cards.blurb: Recorded the steepest Pillar 3 fall among the highlighted countries, dropping 94 places into the bottom-ten group on global alignment.

headline_cards.name: Uruguay
headline_cards.blurb: Entered the shared first-place group on Pillar 3 with a perfect 2025 global-alignment score (tied with Barbados and Cabo Verde at 100.0).

headline_cards.blurb: Moved down sharply on Pillar 3 to sit just above the lowest-alignment cluster (rank 188 of 191).

headline_cards.name: Guatemala
headline_cards.blurb: Posted one of the strongest one-year jumps among the 2025 Pillar 3 top ten.

feature_spotlight.name: Uruguay
feature_spotlight.voting_signal: Recent convergence with the UNGA majority
narrative: Uruguay moved into the shared first-place group on Pillar 3 in 2025, combining a perfect global-alignment score (100.0) with one of the largest one-year rank gains in the dataset (+73 places).
Its movement shows that high alignment in 2025 was not only a matter of long-term stability — some countries converged quickly with prevailing voting patterns.
Uruguay shares the rank-1 slot with Barbados (BRB) and Cabo Verde (CPV); all three reach a perfect 100.0 Pillar 3 score in 2025.

regional_pulse_notes.note_on_placeholder_values: The placeholder values (74.1 / 68.5 / 63.4 / 79.3 / 58.9) do not match Pillar 3 — or any other pillar/total — averages for 2025 under any sensible regional grouping. They appear to be fabricated and have been replaced with computed Pillar 3 means.

validation_notes: Metric confirmed as Pillar 3 (Global Alignment): all four placeholder rank deltas (URY +73, MDG −94, PRY −48, GTM +46) match Pillar 3 ranks exactly. Uruguay's 'perfect 2025 global score' (100.0) and Guatemala's 99.47 both match Pillar 3 Score, not Total Index.
Universe is 191 countries with non-null Pillar 3 Rank in both 2024 and 2025. AFG and VEN are excluded (no 2025 votes recorded).
Uruguay shares rank 1 with Barbados (BRB) and Cabo Verde (CPV) — all three score 100.0 on Pillar 3 in 2025, so 'shared first-place group' is accurate.

If you want the four largest absolute Pillar 3 movements instead of the editorial mix, they are LBR +100 (115 → 15), STP −107 (29 → 136), WSM −100 (24 → 124), MDG −94 (90 → 184). The placeholder picks (URY, MDG, PRY, GTM) are editorially valid but are not the absolute extremes.
Full top-10 risers and top-10 fallers on Pillar 3 are in top_movers_2025.csv.
